queries: Gemini 350 million monthly active users March 2025 court filing
Google blog March 2025 upgrading Google Assistant to Gemini on mobile devices later this year

sources_considered.why: Primary Google announcement of the Assistant-to-Gemini migration and its timing.
Reports the 350M figure, its date, earlier usage, and the distribution channels.

evidence_items.locator: section 'What's next for Google Assistant', paragraph 1

receipt.public_excerpt: Millions of people have already made the switch from Google Assistant to Gemini

evidence_items.explanation: Shows Assistant users were already moving to Gemini before mid-March 2025, but gives no share of the 350M MAU.

evidence_items.locator: section 'What's next for Google Assistant', paragraph 2

receipt.public_excerpt: Over the coming months, we’re upgrading more users on mobile devices from Google Assistant to Gemini

evidence_items.explanation: The wider forced migration was announced for the months after mid-March. That suggests much of it came after the March MAU snapshot, but this does not measure its effect.

receipt.public_excerpt: In the last year, Google has put Gemini in front of millions of users through AI integrations with Samsung phones, Google Workspace applications, and Chrome.

evidence_items.explanation: Names other distribution channels (Samsung, Workspace, Chrome) that may have driven growth, but gives no breakdown.

unresolved_gaps: No public breakdown of Gemini's March 2025 MAU by source, so the share from Assistant migration is unknown.
The month-by-month MAU path between October 2024 (about 90M) and March 2025 (350M) is not public, so a March jump cannot be confirmed or ruled out.
